messages:
olivia: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a lightweight capability negotiation header so we can phase out the legacy payload-envelope without per-tenant manual mapping. TLDR: clients send Capability-Report once (per connection) and router/runtime can decide whether to route to new surface or run a temporary shim. RFC: https://go/rfc/compat-capabilities

jamal: +1. header seems cleaner than adding query flags. how do we authenticate the report (spoofing concerns)?

sarah: prefer self-declared capability, not fingerprinting. mark handshake as 'opt-in' and tie to API key / tenant. store last-seen capability TTL=24h and allow operator override.

kevin: fallback: for clients that don't send header, ingress shim could auto-detect the old `payload=` envelope pattern and rewrite to the new body shape. needs to be cheap and sidecar-friendly. also add a circuit-breaker so shim doesn't become a perf hog under load.

olivia: yep — diagram we discussed: capability -> router policy checks cohort -> either direct to new handler or to shim. We'll treat shim as "best-effort" and add a transformation_cost metric. Also limit per-tenant concurrency through shim.

jamal: telemetry plan: add tags `compat.cohort` and `compat.transformed=true/false`. sample transformed payloads at 1% to S3 for triage. quality monitor should alert if output drift for transformed traffic exceeds threshold (we already have eval harnesses).

sarah: +1. Also: can we auto-generate shim rules from schema diffs? for simple renames / envelope unwraps a generator could emit an envoy/lua transform or a tiny lambda. would cut ops work.

kevin: streaming is the tricky bit — envelope->chatstream mapping isn't always 1:1. suggest auto-shim only for non-streaming endpoints. streaming clients should either opt-in or be routed to a proxy translator that preserves chunking semantics.

olivia: agreed — we call that mode `compat-edge` (explicit tenant opt-in). proposed grace window: 90 days. rollout cohorts: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> off-by-default. fallback policy: transform failures should fall back to legacy handler and emit a `compat.failure` metric.

olivia: header format proposal (single-line header example):

```
Capability-Report: v=1;features=payload-envelope,streaming-v1;client=python-sdk/1.4.3
```

olivia: Action items: @jamal draft telemetry tags + sampling (due Wed). @kevin prototype ingress lua rewrite (P0). @sarah spike auto-shim generator (P1). I'll update RFC with deployment playbook and rollback signals. deplo yer-bot: shim-build triggered for sandbox (job/compat-shim-sandbox) :rocket:

jamal: sounds good. I'll include rollout gates (error-rate, latency, quality regressions) in the playbook.

kevin: will throw up a simple lua transform that strips `payload=` and rewrites body. will include header passthrough and a per-tenant circuit breaker.

sarah: starting a test harness to auto-verify generated transforms against contract tests. should catch most regressions before rollout.

olivia: thanks all — will push updated RFC + playbook this afternoon. :thumbsup:
